title: [RIDGELINE] A (Very) Short Walk With Rich Roll
content:
Ridgeline subscribers —
For years, Kevin Kelly and I have been inviting (to no avail) Rich Roll on Walk and Talks. So it was with great delight that about a month ago, I (Craig Mod, author of this newsletter, Ridgeline; thanks for subscribing) flew out to LA to go on the Rich Roll pod.
Rich is one of those intriguing humans who has made a mega name for himself within a huge swath of narrowly defined people.
